params.1266: Aren't They Supposed To Be Twins?
params.1274: Get a small cage (you can get one free from the fishing shop in Lumbridge).
params.1276: Click on a patch of bubbles to start catching fish.
params.1277: There is a chance you will burn a fish when cooking it, so you may wish to catch several.
params.2225: Catching a crayfish earns you 10 Fishing experience. You can cook the crayfish on a fire or range to make it edible and earn Firemaking experience.
